mechanics.name: Tenacity
mechanics.currentEffect: While in the Dying State, you can recover while crawling, gain 30/40/50% Haste, have your Grunts of Pain reduced by 75%, and your Aura cannot be read.
activation: Ends/deactivates when: The effects end when you leave the Dying State.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.3.0): Re-added recovery while crawling and restored Haste to 30/40/50% (was 15/20/25% from 9.2.0).
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: While downed, lets you crawl and recover at once, move faster, make less pain noise, and hide your Aura.
specialInteractions: Allows recovery while crawling; blocks Aura reading while in the Dying State.

editorial.summary: While downed, recover while crawling, move up to 50% faster, reduce pain sounds, and block Aura reading.
useCases: Crawl toward pallets, teammates, or safer pickup locations without sacrificing recovery progress.
Make slugging harder to manage by moving much farther than the Killer expects.
Hide your downed Aura from Killer information effects while staying quieter.
counters: Provides no ability to fully stand up by itself.
Immediate Killer pickups can deny nearly all value.
Open terrain may offer little useful destination even with faster crawling.
pros: Combines mobility, recovery, quieter audio, and Aura denial.
cons: Can be irrelevant if the Killer hooks immediately.
analysis: Tenacity ranks this position because its current version is much healthier than older memories of the perk. You can once again recover while crawling, and Tier III provides 50% Haste in the Dying State, letting you relocate without choosing between movement and recovery.

That matters around pallets and teammates. A downed Survivor can move into a position where a teammate has a realistic save while still building recovery progress, or crawl away from a dangerous hook area before the Killer returns.
The quieter pain sounds and Aura denial make the relocation harder to track. Those secondary effects are not enough to carry the perk alone, but they support its central anti-slug purpose cleanly.

Tenacity stays in B because it cannot create its own full recovery. It is excellent support for Unbreakable, Power Struggle, Flip-Flop, or teammate pickups, but a Killer who simply hooks you immediately bypasses the entire package.
editorial.verdict: A much better anti-slug utility perk after its 9.5 restoration. Tenacity makes the ground phase productive, but still needs another effect or teammate to actually get you standing.
